title: MXC - a sandboxed code execution system
summary: MXC (Microsoft eXecution Container) is a sandboxed code execution system developed by Microsoft that provides secure, isolated environments for running untrusted code. It leverages Linux namespaces and other containerization technologies to create lightweight execution sandboxes with fine-grained resource control.
problem_solved: Provides secure, isolated execution of untrusted or user-submitted code without risking host system compromise.
why_valuable: Enables developers to safely run arbitrary code from users in a controlled environment, essential for coding platforms, CI/CD systems, and API-based code execution services.
